Subject: Partner enablement: EngagePoint x Redwood — SI Immersion Lab proposal

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the intro last month — excited to kick off a more formal enablement program between EngagePoint and Redwood. Our Solutions team is proposing a 2-day SI Immersion Lab (hands-on) to get our consulting partners certified on the integration patterns and deployment best practices.

High-level ask: can Redwood host a workshop (remote + optional on-site) the week of Oct 19-23? Draft agenda, learning objectives, and a short overview are attached (EP_SI_Immersion_Overview.pdf).

Suggested outcomes:
- One lab-ready reference integration deployed to a sandbox
- 4 partner engineers ramped on deployment/observability flows
- A mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones for joint pilots

Can you confirm Redwood owners for the following: technical lead for lab content, partner ops contact for logistics, and a point for commercial/discount discussion?

Appreciate it — cc'ing our partnerships inbox for visibility.

Best,
Amy Chen
Head of Solutions Partnerships
EngagePoint

Thanks, Amy. Quick technical note and proposed agenda items from our engineering perspective:

Proposed agenda (2-day remote):
Day 1 - Foundations & pairing
- 9:00 - 9:30: Introductions & outcomes
- 9:30 - 11:00: Redwood serving runtime overview (latency, batching, KV cache)
- 11:15 - 12:30: Integration patterns: Connectors, API mapping, auth flows
- 13:30 - 16:00: Guided lab: deploy reference integration -> smoke tests

Day 2 - Ops, quantization & troubleshooting
- 9:00 - 10:30: Observability & Console walkthrough (traces, per-route cost)
- 10:45 - 12:30: Performance tuning: batching, quantization profiles
- 13:30 - 15:30: Failure modes / fallback policies + postmortem exercise
- 15:30 - 16:00: Next steps & MAP assignment

Pre-reqs we need from EngagePoint:
- Short list of APIs and sample payloads (for mock traffic)
- 1-2 test accounts or sandbox keys with reasonable rate limits
- List of attendees with role (eng, infra, CSM) so we can tailor labs

Availability for kickoff call to align scope: Wed Oct 7, 10:00-11:00 PST or Thu Oct 8, 13:00-14:00 PST. Pick one and we'll send calendar invite.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Amy — looping back on logistics. A few operational items to confirm before the kickoff call and lab run: 

1) Lab environment access
- We'll need sandbox API keys from EngagePoint by Oct 12 so our environment team can pre-configure proxies and throttling rules.
- Required: CORS-enabled endpoints, a small test dataset (<= 50MB), and one service account for automated smoke tests.

2) Training modules & artifacts
- We'll publish 3 short modules in advance (15-20m videos) for Day 1 pre-work. Please confirm we can host the pre-reads on your Drive link or if you prefer us to host.

3) Attendance cap and logistics
- Recommended cap: 8 engineers per cohort for hands-on labs. If you expect more, we can split into two cohorts.

I've attached a quick checklist to track items (lab-access-checklist.docx). Can you confirm owners for each row in the MAP by Oct 12? We'll use the MAP to gate any commercial incentives.

Camila Reyes
Partner Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
